HOW TO USE AND PARTICIPATE

To start, check out all the costumes in this sprite. Those are all the ingredients except for the one called "FINAL RESULT".


REMIX THE PROJECT and get inside this sprite once again.

Now you want to make your enchilada. 
Press AND hold "W" until a list appears. It should be empty.

Time to "cook"! 

-Use the A and D keys to scroll through the ingredients.

-Press space to add an ingredient to the list. You can do this as many times as you want, but DON'T spam it hard.

-Use X to delete the last ingredient in the list, or hold W to reset your enchilada.

(RECOMMENDED: view all ingredients carefully!)


Finished? SAVE YOUR REMIX!
Go to the "FINAL RESULT" costume. That is what you will "aesthetically" show the judges, along with the list of all the ingredients. Draw your enchilada!

Now, you can press "0" to see all your ingredients being cooked to make sure you're satisfied with your creation. If you ARE, share the project! Make sure to double-check your enchilada's ingredients were not deleted.

JULY 4TH IS THE DEADLINE.
